# Agentic Field Notes

> Static educational blog on agentic AI orchestration (graphs, Mongo, RAG, evaluation).

## Primary entry

- Home: index.html
- Agentic Development (20 steps): agentic-development/index.html

## Topics

- Graph orchestration with LangGraph-style pipelines
- MongoDB schemas for chat, turns, pending forms, checkpoints
- RAG as tool-based retrieval with ACL
- Golden JSON evaluation and observability
- Langfuse Lab: traces list, span tree, token/cost detail (with screenshots)
- LLM engineering, prompts & tools, security for AI, testing as an AI developer

## Format

Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no authentication, suitable for indexing and citation.
